# Northern Frame / Северный кадр
> Northern Frame produces bilingual documentary films and brand narratives in the Arctic, specializing in expedition logistics and authentic storytelling for tourism and outdoor brands.

## Pages & Specifications
- [Home](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/northern_frame_enru/): Expedition-grade Arctic documentaries for outdoor brands. Bilingual storytelling, 4K capture, and 10-day pre-production turnaround.
- [Services](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/northern_frame_enru/services.html): Expedition documentaries, brand films, and short promos. Cold-weather certified teams, bilingual scripting, and Arctic logistics coordination.
- [Portfolio](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/northern_frame_enru/portfolio.html): View our Arctic documentary projects for tourism and outdoor brands. 4K RAW footage, color-graded deliverables, and bilingual narratives.
- [About](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/northern_frame_enru/about.html): Meet our cold-weather certified cinematographers, producers, and sound engineers. Founded in 2017 in Murmansk with a Kirovsk office.
- [Contact](https://vkvstudio.github.io/SmartLLM/northern_frame_enru/contact.html): Contact Northern Frame for expedition film quotes. Based in Murmansk, open Mon-Fri 10:00-19:00. Email hello@northernframe.ru.

## Products & Prices (single source of truth)
- Expedition Documentary: Full production including pre-production, 10-day shoot, post-production, and bilingual delivery — 1,200,000 RUB
- Brand Film: 3-minute narrative film with scripted interviews and cinematic B-roll — 450,000 RUB
- Short Promo: 60-second social media cut with licensed music and subtitles — 150,000 RUB

## Brand History
- Founded: 2017
- 2017 — Founded in Murmansk
- 2019 — First international co-production with Norwegian tourism board
- 2021 — Expanded to Kirovsk office
